reason: Although framed as a performance improvement, this PR touches core statistics update paths across bootstrap, cache, DDL subscription, storage save/update/gc, and stats table structures, plus session bootstrap. That is central optimizer infrastructure: mistakes here can corrupt or stale planner statistics, break upgrade/bootstrap behavior, or introduce concurrency/persistence bugs with broad query-planning impact. The change surface is too wide and too close to statistics correctness to treat as a routine optimization.
